an10.111:1.1: Then a bhikkhu went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:
an10.111:2.1: “Sir, they speak of the one called ‘an adept’.
an10.111:2.2: How is an adept bhikkhu defined?”
an10.111:2.3: “Bhikkhu, it’s when a bhikkhu has an adept’s right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right concentration, right knowledge, and right freedom.
an10.111:2.4: That’s how a bhikkhu is an adept.”
